summary: IEEE-library form of combined line and phase voltmeter selector: this representation identifies a selector covering phase-to-phase and phase-to-neutral voltage measurements.
description: This reference locates combined line and phase voltmeter selector in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. This representation identifies a selector covering phase-to-phase and phase-to-neutral voltage measurements. One selector covers both line-to-line and line-to-neutral measurements. The measurement function changes with position even though the meter and its physical terminals remain the same. The public library uses HSW1S92 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

List the selected conductor pair or phase/reference path for every position. Use the selected switch’s contact programme instead of inferring connections from the face labels alone. Provide a position table specifying each measurement path. The symbol cannot replace the actual switch contact programme. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
